sloka: सान्त्वयित्वा तु तां रामो रुदन्तीं जनकात्मजाम् ।उवाच लक्ष्मणं तत्र दु:खितो दु:खितं वच: ॥ २.१०२.१९॥
transliteration: sāntvayitvā tu tāṁ rāmo rudantīṁ janakātmajām ।uvāca lakṣmaṇaṁ tatra du:khito du:khitaṁ vaca: ॥ 2.102.19॥

translations.english: Having consoled Sita, daughter of Janaka, griefstricken Rama said to Lakshmana who was also distressed with grief.
